resources.string: Nothing was heard. Tap to try again.
The microphone could not start. Tap to try again.
Microphone access is needed to dictate.
Recording kept. Tap retry to send it.
Mac unreachable. Is it awake and on your network or Tailscale? Tap retry.
Token rejected by the Mac. Pair again, then retry.
No model selected on the Mac. Choose one in VoiceInk, then retry.
Transcription failed on the Mac. Tap retry.
The Mac returned an error (%1$s). Tap retry.
Unexpected reply from the Mac. Tap retry.
Switch back to the previous keyboard
Dictate into any app through VoiceInk on your Mac, then return to your usual keyboard.
On the Mac, open VoiceInk → Settings → Phone Dictation and turn on Allow Phone Dictation. Scan its code, or type an address and the token shown there (Copy).
Paired with %1$s. It will transcribe with %2$s.
Wrong token: the Mac rejected it. Copy the current token from VoiceInk, or scan the code again.
Can\'t reach %1$s on port %2$d. Check that the Mac is awake, Allow Phone Dictation is on, and the phone is on the same network or Tailscale.
Paired with %1$s, but no transcription model is selected there. Choose one in VoiceInk before dictating.
The Mac answered unexpectedly. Make sure VoiceInk is up to date.
The Mac rejected the saved token, probably because it was regenerated. Scan the new code or enter the new token.
The QR scanner isn\'t available on this phone. Enter the address and token instead.
That isn\'t a VoiceInk pairing code.
This code is for a newer VoiceInk. Update this app.
That address isn\'t valid. Use an IP address or host name.
The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
The VoiceInk keyboard records your voice only while you dictate, and sends it only to your paired Mac to turn it into text.
Microphone allowed. Audio is recorded only while dictating and sent only to your Mac.
VoiceInk voice is turned on. Keep your usual keyboard as the default.
Not turned on yet. In the list, turn on VoiceInk voice, then come back.

While any keyboard is open, tap the keyboard button at the bottom right of the navigation bar, or long-press the space bar (SwiftKey, Samsung Keyboard and Gboard), and choose VoiceInk voice. After dictating it returns to your keyboard by itself; the keyboard icon on it goes back without dictating.\n\nSamsung: to show that button, turn on Settings → General management → Keyboard list and default → Keyboard button on navigation bar.
